name: bysound-examples
description: Runnable examples for bysound. They import ../web/src directly and use web/'s toolchain: run `npm ci` in ../web once.

scripts.build:web: for d in web-chat web-file web-wifi-setup web-channel-ladder; do ../web/node_modules/.bin/vite build $d -c vite.config.ts || exit 1; done
scripts.node:encode: npm run -s build:node && node dist-node/cli.mjs encode
scripts.node:decode: npm run -s build:node && node dist-node/cli.mjs decode
